source_logs: November 5-6, 2026: 10 physical episode directories; complete inventory in z_direction_summary.json

findings.finding: Raw predictions contain both positive and negative BASE Z. Early trajectories descend; later predictions also request ascent.

MoveLine request target Z minus current controller Z equals logged limited Z, max absolute discrepancy 5.674e-14 mm over analyzed requests. No systematic Z sign inversion at this conversion was found.

Raw/limited Z signs can differ because the stateful acceleration limiter retains previous velocity. Latest MoveLine step 36: raw -0.360211 mm, limited/submitted +0.602644 mm, observed FK +0.573479 mm.

Latest MoveLine steps 43-100 repeatedly request ascent, report successful service ACK, yet joints essentially do not move. FK net Z change over this suffix is only +0.000792 mm. 58 analyzed requests coincide with driver alarm 1206 NOT REACHABLE.
findings.interpretation: Unreachable target is directly supported. The exact IK/singularity/joint-limit feasibility failure mechanism and vendor true-return semantics are not uniquely established.

findings.finding: Successful service return and STANDBY were insufficient to validate actual target arrival; the runner can continue after no-motion/unreachable responses.
findings.recommended_followup_not_implemented: Add independent command-versus-feedback/target-reach checks and controller alarm ingestion; investigate pose feasibility and joint configuration, not arbitrary sign reversal or higher action/speed limits.

findings.finding: ServoL raw delta, limited target delta and actual submitted absolute stream poses are distinct. Continuous response windows show differing signs; inertia, virtual target interpolation and following delay can contribute. A single unique cause for every mismatch is not established.
11:14 and 12:53 ServoL runs terminate with alarm 9008: joint 5 about -137.5 degrees versus controller minimum -135 degrees; this is separate from a simple Z sign inversion.

limitations: Actual trajectory here means nominal URDF flange FK reconstructed from measured joints, not independent optical TCP feedback.
No formal active TCP verification is asserted.
Servo windows are timestamp-associated, not isolated command-response experiments. Previous commands and stop transients may contribute.
ZERO uses numerical epsilon 1e-9 mm, not an engineering accuracy tolerance; tiny nonzero changes are not meaningful task movement.
Predictions rejected before dispatch and commands missing a complete before/after record are not treated as completed motion comparisons.
new_offline_tests: 3 PASS; no ROS import or command transport in the analysis script
